summary: Sharpened the precondition of the snapshot-boundary loop and corrected an over-general reading. The harness now runs the same legal sealed-partition five-node history in three cases: (TrailingLogs=0, no post-snapshot entries), (TrailingLogs=10, 20 post-snapshot entries) and (TrailingLogs=25, 20 post-snapshot entries). Local construction feedback: only the first loops — successor snapshot at index 4 with store 0/0, rejoin_observe restores_early 723 / late 733, partner applied index pinned at 4 and last index stuck at 7; both nonzero cases leave the successor's store at 1..24 because at snapshot time its log had not yet extended TrailingLogs past the snapshot index, and the peer converges with zero snapshot installs to applied and last index 24. The discriminating arithmetic is compactLogsWithTrailing, which returns without deleting when lastLogIdx <= trailingLogs and otherwise deletes only up to min(snapshotIndex, lastLogIdx − trailingLogs); since a snapshot is taken at the FSM's applied index, the deletion passes the snapshot boundary only when lastLogIdx − trailingLogs >= snapshotIndex, i.e. when the log end is at least TrailingLogs ahead of the snapshot index at snapshot time — guaranteed by TrailingLogs=0, but not by a routine periodic snapshot in a caught-up cluster. Recorded as a Behavior knowledge entry (@b-compaction-precondition) and as an unresolved source-only interpretation, with the honest counterevidence (both nonzero cases converge, and they are the same effect as the earlier TrailingLogs=3 control, not a second protection) and the limitations (no threshold bisection, the harness snapshots only through the user API at a quiet moment, so the threshold-triggered snapshot under a live write backlog — the configuration this narrowed precondition points at — was not executed). Neither asserted result is weakened: the single-peer witness and the sealed-partition witness both ran with TrailingLogs=0 and remain scoped to their executed bases, while the practical trigger is now stated in terms of deployment parameters. Structural validation returned valid=true.
